title.narrative: Gross domestic expenditure on R&D (%GDP)

description.narrative: It measures current and capital expenditures on creative work undertaken systematically to increase knowledge, including knowledge of humanity, culture, and society, and the use of knowledge for new applications. R&D covers basic research, applied research, and experimental development. It is considered one of the most reliable proxy to measure innovation and public/private engagement to innovation (data.worldbank.org). There is strong evidence of positive correlation with other measure of economic development, growth and employment. This is also one of the subindicators of the HDI (hdr.undp.org). Finally, it is the indicator used to measure SDG 9
